pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In even tacking, the stitches and gaps are (1 mark)
   A. Absent
   B. Very long
   C. Different lengths
   D. The same length

2. What can an agricultural extension officer help with? (1 mark)
   A. Cooking meals
   B. Advice on which varieties and methods suit your area
   C. Selling your tools
   D. Building a house

3. What should you do if oil in a pan catches fire? (1 mark)
   A. Carry the pan outside quickly
   B. An adult covers the pan with a lid and turns off the heat
   C. Pour water on it
   D. Blow on it

4. Which skill from Mathematics helps in tacking? (1 mark)
   A. Adding money
   B. Telling time
   C. Measuring
   D. Naming shapes only

5. Why should the soil be firmed around a newly planted seedling? (1 mark)
   A. To make the plant fall
   B. To remove air spaces and hold the roots
   C. To hide it
   D. To dry the roots

6. Which PPE protects the nose and mouth from dust? (1 mark)
   A. Dust mask
   B. Gloves
   C. Gumboots
   D. Overall

7. What should you do with laces when cleaning canvas shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Leave them dirty
   B. Remove and wash them separately
   C. Cut them
   D. Burn them

8. Which of these is a domestic animal? (1 mark)
   A. Zebra
   B. Lion
   C. Giraffe
   D. Goat

9. Which is a mistake in tacking? (1 mark)
   A. Making stitches of different lengths in even tacking
   B. Using contrasting thread
   C. Using small back stitch at the end
   D. Marking the line first

10. Which part is often forgotten when washing hands? (1 mark)
   A. The elbows only
   B. Under the nails and between the fingers
   C. The knees
   D. Only the palms

11. Which food is a good source of protein and cheap in many homes? (1 mark)
   A. Sugar
   B. Beans
   C. Soda
   D. Salt

12. Which method wipes dust from furniture? (1 mark)
   A. Dusting
   B. Mopping
   C. Burning
   D. Sweeping

13. What is the young one of a goat called? (1 mark)
   A. Chick
   B. Lamb
   C. Kid
   D. Calf

14. Which PPE would you wear on your hands to handle dirty things? (1 mark)
   A. Dust mask
   B. Gloves
   C. Headgear
   D. Gumboots

15. What should you do first for a small burn? (1 mark)
   A. Put butter on it
   B. Cover with toothpaste
   C. Ignore it
   D. Cool it under running clean water for at least ten minutes

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why should an adult make the holes in the pipe? (2 marks)

17. Explain the steps for dusting a room. (4 marks)

18. What is meant by coexisting with wild animals? (2 marks)

19. Name three improvised cleaning tools and what each is made from. (3 marks)

20. Explain two mistakes that can spoil a newly planted fruit tree and how to avoid them. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — The same length
   Even tacking is equal.

2. B — Advice on which varieties and methods suit your area
   Extension officers advise farmers.

3. B — An adult covers the pan with a lid and turns off the heat
   Water makes an oil fire worse.

4. C — Measuring
   Measuring gives even and accurate stitches.

5. B — To remove air spaces and hold the roots
   Air pockets dry out roots.

6. A — Dust mask
   A dust mask covers the nose and mouth.

7. B — Remove and wash them separately
   Laces need to be washed too.

8. D — Goat
   Goats are kept by farmers.

9. A — Making stitches of different lengths in even tacking
   Stitches should be equal.

10. B — Under the nails and between the fingers
   Germs hide there.

11. B — Beans
   Beans are protein-rich.

12. A — Dusting
   Dusting removes dust from surfaces.

13. C — Kid
   A young goat is a kid.

14. B — Gloves
   Gloves cover the hands.

15. D — Cool it under running clean water for at least ten minutes
   Cooling reduces burn damage.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Nails and awls are sharp and can hurt children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sharp tools, 1 mark for safety or injuries.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Open windows; use a slightly damp clean cloth; dust from high to low; shake and wash the duster outside.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four steps.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Living together peacefully so that both farmers and animals are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for living together, 1 mark for both safe.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Duster from old cloth; mop from strips of cloth on a stick; dustpan from a cut jerrican.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tool with material.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Burying the graft joint under the soil, plant with joint above the ground; not watering in dry weather, water regularly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mistake and 1 for each solution.
